b_source: derived/cap4/sealed_2b3316b6-7f6e-474f-9177-bd5a89aeb58c/analysis.json power_law_fit. Arm identified by the sealed median prefill at n=46000.
n_ref_rule: Highest n on the reference arm whose completed repeats have median prefill_s <= 10 and which is not above an all-fail n. ttft_ref is that median. 8B n_ref is 3312 (two passes at 3.19 s and 3.21 s; one memory_wall). 3625 is the first all-fail, so 3312 is the last measured SLO-ok prefill. highest_slo_ok_n stays 3156 because that is the last n where every repeat passed. 4B-int8 n_ref is 7781. 7937 is an all-fail and the single pass at 8250 sits above that wall, so it is not the reference. 4B-int4 n_ref is highest_slo_ok_n 9750. The median at 10000 is 10.079 s.
n_wall_rule: KV-only image of the first memory-fail n: n_fail * (147456 / 73728) = n_fail * 2. A null n_wall means the reference cell never hit a memory wall. predicted = min(n_slo, n_wall) when n_wall is present, else n_slo. kind is whichever number is smaller.
wall_estimate_rule: Ceiling cells use max(2x existing generation.wall_s, planned_probes * 10 * 0.75 + 180). planned_probes = 3 * (ceil(log2((high-low)/250)) + 1). The 10 s term is the SLO prefill at n_slo. 180 s covers model load and the canary probes the 9750 anchor never fired. 8B and 4B-int8 use the probe model because their f16 runs died at a memory wall and under-count a higher SLO bisection. 4B-int4 uses the measured 2x (368 s), which is larger than the probe model. DET-PROBE stays 1200 s. CPU stays 2010 s because its predicted limit did not move up.
